title: Log "no token found" when the Rig service token is missing
head: codex/no-token-log
body:
## What

Log `no token found` when the Rig service token is missing.

When `rig.service_token` is missing from the OS keychain, the service writes one line to the activity log:
- action: `token`
- outcome: `no token found: rig.service_token is not set in the OS keychain (service OASIS)`

When the token has an invalid shape:
- outcome: `invalid token: rig.service_token in the OS keychain has an invalid shape (service OASIS)`

Typed errors `ServiceTokenMissing` and `ServiceTokenInvalid` in `local_service_auth.py`, caught by type.

Startup still refuses to run. The error the user or CLI sees stays generic ("the Rig service token is unavailable" / "is invalid"), so keychain detail lives only in the log. No token value is ever logged.

**Decision #46.**

## Checks (rerun by coordinator)

- `pytest -q` → 375 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected
- `ruff check .` → All checks passed
- `ruff format --check .` → 62 files already formatted
- `mypy --strict src` → no issues in 31 files (native and `--platform win32`)
- `git diff --check` → clean

## Related

Pairs with merged RDW-Labz/desktop-app#4, whose screen shows only "Not connected yet".

**Files:** `src/anorak/local_service.py`, `src/anorak/local_service_auth.py`, `tests/test_local_service.py`, `docs/local-service.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

Built by two swarm-CLI Haiku jobs; the coordinator's review caught that the first version picked log text by matching error words and leaked keychain detail into stderr; the second job fixed both.
